description.narrative: Bidrag till Energistödsfonden för Ukraina genom Energigemenskapens sekretariat. Fonden används för att finansiera de mest akuta behoven hos ukrainska energiföretag, såsom utrustning, reservdelar och andra tekniska artiklar, samt bränslen och tjänster som behövs för att reparera infrastruktur och upprätthålla energi- och värmeförsörjningen i Ukraina.

Contribution to the Ukraine Energy Support Fund through the Energy Community Secretariat. The Fund is used to finance the most urgent needs of Ukrainian energy companies, such as equipment, spare parts and other technical items, as well as fuel and services needed to repair infrastructure and maintain energy and heat supply in Ukraine.

The overall objective of the Ukraine Energy Support Fund (UESF) is to ensure that the energy system in Ukraine is functioning in a stable manner, providing energy consumers with uninterrupted supply of electricity, which in turn enables a stable supply of heating, water, and sanitation services in the country.
The theory of change behind the UESF is that by providing assistance to energy-related companies in Ukraine, they will be able to procure services and replenish their stock of goods, such as equipment, repair materials, infrastructure components, and fuel, necessary to ensure the stable functioning of the energy system. This assistance will not only help these companies restore their operations but also enable them to upgrade their systems, which will help to increase their resilience to future challenges.
The UESF's specific objective is to restore the resilience of the Ukrainian energy system through support to energy-related companies.
The UESF aims to achieve this objective by providing assistance to companies to procure necessary goods and services to restore and upgrade their systems. This assistance will, in turn, ensure the stable functioning of the energy system and provide energy consumers with uninterrupted supply, contributing to the overall stability of the country.
The Swedish funds are to contribute to the UESF specific objective as well as to a component on solar microgrids in social infrastructure aiming to achieve an enhanced resilience to climate change, conflict, and increased energy independence of the social infrastructure in Ukraine. To achieve this latter outcome, the project will deliver renewable energy-based microgrid packages to supply electricity to social public buildings in Ukraine.

tag.narrative: 7.1 - By 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.
7.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa allmän tillgång till ekonomiskt överkomliga, tillförlitliga och moderna energitjänster.

7.a - By 2030, enhance international cooperation to facilitate access to clean energy research and technology, including renewable energy, energy efficiency and advanced and cleaner fossil-fuel technology, and promote investment in energy infrastructure and clean energy technology.

7.a - Till 2030 stärka det internationella samarbetet för att underlätta tillgång till forskning och teknik inom ren energi, inklusive förnybar energi, energieffektivitet samt avancerad och renare fossilbränslebaserad teknik, samt främja investeringar i energiinfrastruktur och ren energiteknik.

9.1 - Bygga ut tillförlitlig, hållbar och motståndskraftig infrastruktur av hög kvalitet, inklusive regional och gränsöverskridande infrastruktur, för att stödja ekonomisk utveckling och människors välbefinnande, med fokus på ekonomiskt överkomlig och rättvis tillgång för alla.

9.1 - Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure, including regional and transborder infrastructure, to support economic development and human well-being, with a focus on affordable and equitable access for all.
